Author: Legends of the Game
Name: Tales of Milestones
Description: Quest progression and pacing — a reflective notebook for your story journey, not a scoreboard.
Punchline: Remember every step, Warriors of Light.
Changelog:
Tales of Milestones:
- Eat buttons on the Bonuses tab. Each meal in your inventory has an Eat button. One click eats one meal. The button is not available when the game refuses the meal.
- Eat button in /tm food. The food window has the same button for a meal that is in your inventory.
- /tm eat. `/tm eat dps`, `tank`, `healer`, `battle`, `craft`, `gather` or `all` eats your meal of that kind when you hold only one such meal. When you hold more than one, the Bonuses tab opens and you select the meal.
- Playtime in the export. The export adds the time that the plugin recorded after your last `/playtime` reply, so the playtime is current at the time of the export. The plugin does not run `/playtime`.
- Armor, GARO and more weapons in the export. "Copy collections" and "Copy everything" now include relic armor, GARO gear, and the Figmental, Exquisite and Deep Dungeon weapons.
- The native windows use less processor time. The at-a-glance window and the tabs of the main window now update one time each second, not on each frame. In a test, the at-a-glance window changed from about 1.2 ms to about 0.08 ms for each frame.
- Fix: the plugin no longer writes its settings file every 5 seconds while Cosmic Exploration data is loaded. It writes the file only when a tool's progress changes.
- Fix: the job list on the Progression tab no longer scrolls past its end.
- KamiToolKit is updated to its current version.
Adventurer's Ledger (Pandora Lunar):
- New layout. Next Steps is the first screen. It shows 5 cards for what to do next, and "Show 5 more" shows 10. Daily, Weekly and Seasonal rows are below it in the rail. The header shows the area title, the age of your data and 4 clocks.
- Challenge Log. Each Challenge Log entry has its own row, with links and typed counts. Suggested and Completed groups are included.
- Routine sub-checks. A routine can have its own boxes: one for each roulette, a Tank You pick, 12 allied society boxes and Grand Company chips. "Edit routines" changes the rows.
- Relics by job. The Relics area has a By job view and line cards with progress bars. To fill the Armor and GARO frames, update Tales of Milestones to this version and import a new export.
- Societies, currents and collections. Societies show unlock lines and rank bars. Aether currents are listed by zone. Collections are grouped by availability, with Online Store links.
- Settings area. Character, display, and backup and import settings are in one area. The Ledger holds up to 8 characters, and times can show in UTC or local time.
- Themes. The three themes are Lunar night, Crystarium and Light. Expansion tags use the colours of the Lodestone patch notes.
- Jobs meter. The rail has a Jobs meter that adds your combat, crafting and gathering levels, out of 3,330.
- Fix: after an import, the relic row in the list of changes counts relic items. Before, a stage upgrade showed no change, for example "9 to 9".
